items.claim: He manages range well when pushing opponents backward and avoids taking multiple consecutive steps straight back.
items.quote: he keeps that range really well, but I think what he does well, especially when you're fighting someone who's grapple heavy, is he doesn't or he very rarely takes two or three steps backwards.

items.claim: He uses efficient footwork to walk opponents down with straight shots rather than wasting energy.
items.quote: he's efficient with his footwork. He's not wasting any energy. He's just kind of like walking his opponent down and coming with the the straight shots.

items.claim: He utilizes much of his striking primarily to set up his grappling.
items.quote: A lot of his striking is to set up his grappling

items.claim: He has never shown any signs of fatigue or getting tired in the late rounds.
items.quote: Ian's never showed any signs of like fatigue or getting tired late in the late rounds or anything like that.
